findings.actual_failure: The test asserts less than the plan states for it; no shipped behavior is wrong, since a stale cap could only matter for a refusal that carries a retry count and no such early refusal exists.
findings.observation: The case that issues a report refusal right after a status call in one process cannot detect a leaked routing context, because the dispatcher rewrites the verb before every emit and emit skips usage errors.
findings.reachable_path: Removing both routing-context clear calls in the main wrapper leaves that test green; it still catches an emit that adds route for other verbs.
findings.rule_ref: T4 test claim: the report-after-status case stops a routing context that outlives its call

findings.actual_failure: A malformed shipped policy turns a refusal-shaped failure into a traceback for every verb, changing the output and exit code of verbs that never needed the cap.
findings.observation: The retry cap is read from the policy for every verb before any error handler, and the policy loader never checks that key.
findings.reachable_path: A policy missing the retry cap key, or holding a non-integer, makes park, start, next, report, resolve-effect and status die with an uncaught error and no JSON answer; before this change only status --check read it, inside the internal-error handler.
findings.rule_ref: Spec Agent Rules: keep every refusal code, exit code and what each check accepts as it is today; module contract: every verb prints one JSON object

findings.actual_failure: The test pins less than its name claims; no shipped behavior differs.
findings.observation: The usage-error guard in the answer printer never changes the result, because a usage payload has neither a run view nor a refusal.
findings.reachable_path: Removing the guard leaves the usage-error test green.
findings.rule_ref: Test quality: every guard has a case that can fail

findings.actual_failure: Those verbs print a traceback and no JSON object where they printed normal JSON before the route work; the repair tests only cover a missing key and a non-numeric string.
findings.observation: The guarded retry cap read catches a missing key, a wrong type and a non-numeric string but not an overflow, so a policy cap of Infinity still raises out of the dispatcher.
findings.reachable_path: A policy holding Infinity as the retry cap, which JSON parsing accepts, makes int() of the parsed float raise an overflow error on park, start, report, resolve-effect and a fresh status or next, with no JSON answer.
findings.rule_ref: Spec Agent Rules: keep every refusal code, exit code and what each check accepts as it is today; every verb prints one JSON object

findings.actual_failure: The test asserts less than its name claims; the shipped guard itself behaves correctly and no acceptance criterion is broken.
findings.observation: The unreadable-cap test compares only the exit codes of the sound and faulty runs and then checks only whether a route key is present, so the claim that every verb keeps its output is not pinned field for field.
findings.reachable_path: A guard that changed another field of a verb's answer, or set the cap to something other than none, would leave the test green; its status check cannot fail on a fresh repository.
findings.rule_ref: Test quality: a test named for output equality compares the output
